{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America calls for a full federal civil rights investigation into the killing of Michael Brown.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America calls for an end to the militarization of local police forces.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The action of the Ferguson, Missouri, police department exemplifies the dangers to the lives of ordinary Americans, particularly people of color, posed by overly aggressive, heavily armed police forces.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Over the past thirty years, federal, state and local government have abandoned commitments to fighting poverty and unemployment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Poverty and unemployment disproportionately limit the life opportunities of young persons of color.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Most low income youth only encounter the state as a repressive force that relegates them to a life within the prison-industrial complex, even for the most minor and non-violent of drug-related offenses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"These activities rarely lead white youth to be arrested, let alone imprisoned.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"In the case of Ferguson, Missouri, police-mandated media blackouts and the pervasive detainment, harassment and arrest of journalists cloud public understanding of the ongoing crisis.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The constant barrage of tear gas canisters into crowds, backyards and neighborhood streets in recent days has further hampered a full understanding of the situation on the ground in Ferguson, Missouri.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
